title: Bump typescript-eslint from 8.55.0 to 8.72.1 in /plugin/skills/tenet-starter-ts-web-api/template
body:
Bumps [typescript-eslint](https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/tree/HEAD/packages/typescript-eslint) from 8.55.0 to 8.72.1.
Release notes

Sourced from typescript-eslint's releases.

v8.72.1

8.72.1 (2026-10-26)

🩹 Fixes

  • eslint-plugin: [no-unnecessary-condition] false positives on unresolved conditional types (#13062)
  • eslint-plugin: [no-unnecessary-type-assertion] bound recursive type traversal instead of catching stack overflows (#13039)
  • typescript-estree: use one Program per tsconfig for the project service in single-run mode (#12988)

❤️ Thank You

  • Evyatar Daud @​StyleShit
  • Josh Ghoulberg 👻

See GitHub Releases for more information.

You can read about our versioning strategy and releases on our website.

v8.72.0

8.72.0 (2026-10-19)

🚀 Features

  • eslint-plugin: lazy load rules (#13010)
  • eslint-plugin: [await-thenable] add allowMixedPromiseArrays option (#12992)
  • typescript-estree: error on abstract keyword that precedes export (#13019)

🩹 Fixes

  • ast-spec: add JSXFragment to JSXAttribute['value'] (#13051)
  • eslint-plugin: [prefer-readonly-parameter-types] check where allowed type aliases are declared (#13016)
  • eslint-plugin: [no-deprecated] report deprecated properties in object literals (#12704)
  • eslint-plugin: use isTypeLiteralType instead of type.isLiteral() to include bigint literals on TS < 5.0 (#13053)
  • eslint-plugin: [require-array-sort-compare] check tuples (#13058)
  • eslint-plugin: [require-array-sort-compare] ignore extra this type argument on TS < 5.1 (#13055)
  • type-utils: discriminateAnyType crashes when calling getAwaitedType on awaited type in TS < 5.0 (#13054)
  • typescript-estree: include leading and trailing comments & whitespace in Program range (#12991)

❤️ Thank You

  • Evyatar Daud @​StyleShit
  • Junichiro Kasuya @​jksy
  • Mitch Fultz @​fitchmultz
  • Shaan GS @​ShaanGS

See GitHub Releases for more information.

You can read about our versioning strategy and releases on our website.
